Problems we solve.

WHAT WE DELIVER

Scope of work.

The exact scope, schedule, and price are confirmed in a written quotation.

HOW AN ENGAGEMENT WORKS

From first conversation to handover.

  1. 01

    Site survey

    We visit your site, review existing equipment, and agree requirements.

  2. 02

    Design & quotation

    We propose a design, bill of materials, schedule, and quotation.

  3. 03

    Install & test

    We install, configure, and test with minimal disruption to operations.

  4. 04

    Handover

    You receive full documentation, with the option of ongoing support.

QUESTIONS

Common questions.

Used in: Trading & Distribution, Warehousing & Logistics, Manufacturing, Corporate Offices

Can you work outside business hours?

Yes. Installation and cut-overs can be scheduled in the evening or at weekends to avoid disrupting operations, as agreed in the quotation.

Do you supply the equipment as well?

Yes. We can procure the hardware and implement it under one quotation, or install equipment you already own.

Which areas do you cover?

Jakarta, Tangerang, Bekasi, Cikarang, and the wider Greater Jakarta area. Sites further away are considered per project.
